cases.page.title: Cases
cases.page.subtitle: Real problems I faced and how I solved them. Each case shows the technical reasoning behind the deliveries.
cases.pagarme.title: Full Payment Gateway Integration (Pagar.me v5)
cases.pagarme.problem: The platform used a different payment gateway, but the company decided to migrate to Pagar.me v5 — a completely different API (authentication, values in cents, distinct endpoints, native split logic). The migration had to happen without breaking the existing system, supporting PIX, Credit Card, Boleto, payment splitting, and card tokenization.
cases.pagarme.approach: I created an architecture based on the Factory Pattern that allows switching between payment gateways by simply changing an environment variable, without touching any business logic. I built a unified interface with standardized methods for customer creation, payments, cards, transfers and refunds. The provider supports PIX, Credit Card and Boleto, with automatic payment splitting between seller, platform and carrier. Beyond the main implementation, I solved critical production issues: the antifraud system was rejecting transactions due to outdated data, bank branches came in unexpected formats, payment notifications were not arriving, and deleted gateway customers were blocking the flow. Each of these problems received a resilient and automatic solution.
cases.pagarme.result: Gateway migrated and running in production with zero downtime. The Factory architecture enables gateway switching with a single configuration change. Payment splitting fully automated. All edge cases covered with resilient solutions.
cases.saas.title: Multi-tenant B2B SaaS Platforms
cases.saas.problem: The client needed a platform connecting dealerships, retailers and service providers in the automotive sector. The architecture had to support multiple tenants with data isolation, complex permissions and integrated payment flows.
cases.saas.approach: I architected a Multi-tenant solution with granular RBAC using Next.js on the front and Node.js + Prisma on the back. I implemented garage management, auction systems, subscription plans and payment integration with Pagar.me. Each tenant has its own data scope with isolation middleware.
cases.saas.result: Platform delivered and running in production with multiple simultaneous clients. The RBAC system allows fine-grained permission control by role, and the Pagar.me integration automated 100% of the financial flow.

cases.chat.title: Real-Time Chat with File Upload
cases.chat.problem: In an e-commerce project, the team needed to implement image and file sharing in a real-time chat using Firebase. The QA and back-end developer were stuck, unsure how to integrate file uploads with the real-time messaging system in a secure and performant way.
cases.chat.approach: I proposed the solution directly to the team: the back-end would create an authenticated file upload route for the chat. Instead of sending the image directly to Firebase, the front-end would call this route with the file, receive the hosted image URL, and then send that URL as a message in Firebase. This way, Firebase only stores the reference (URL) and the front-end automatically renders the message as an image.
cases.chat.result: Solution implemented and running in production. The flow became secure (authenticated route), performant (Firebase handles only text) and scalable. The team adopted this pattern for all media types in the chat.
cases.dashboard.title: Complex Admin & B2B Dashboards
cases.dashboard.problem: Multiple company projects required complex admin dashboards for e-commerce, social networks and internal tools. Each with unique business rules, heavy integrations and pixel-perfect Figma interfaces.
cases.dashboard.approach: I developed a reusable component system in React + TypeScript + Styled-Components that accelerated new dashboard delivery. I created REST API integration patterns, state management and dynamic tables with advanced filters.
cases.dashboard.result: Delivered over 5 high-complexity dashboards. The design system reduced development time on new projects and ensured visual consistency across all products.
